key.description: Dot-namespaced, e.g. mail.sender_name. Immutable once created.

is_sensitive.description: Encrypted at rest and never returned in plaintext once set.

ConfigurationUpdateRequest.description: All fields optional — only the ones sent are changed.

value.description: Always null when is_sensitive is true — this endpoint never reveals a sensitive value.

key.description: Dot-namespaced, e.g. user.welcome. Together with channel and locale, must be unique.

locale.description: e.g. en, es, en_US. Falls back to "en" at delivery time when no exact-locale template exists.

subject.description: Sandboxed Twig source (if/for only, a short filter allowlist, no method/property access).

body.description: Sandboxed Twig source, same restrictions as subject.

NotificationTemplateUpdateRequest.description: All fields optional — only the ones sent are changed. key/channel/locale are immutable once created.

folder.description: The listed folder; null at the root level.

_result.description: Operation result (shape depends on the endpoint)

ApiError.description: Body of every error response. `code` is a stable identifier (e.g. `security.bad_credentials`, `note.not_found`) meant to be mapped to a translation key by clients.
